integrity: The exact moment interpolation is known from previous literature and is not claimed as new; the new theorem is the positive-kernel derivation of all-order strict normalized-moment log-convexity and strict cross-order comparison. Numerical checks are supplementary, not proofs.
scientific_limitations: Only mean-zero sums of at most three independent rate-one exponential variables are covered; all real exponents \(p\ge2\), no assertion for four or more terms or \(p<2\). Residual unindexed-priority risk.
title: Strict Gaussian-normalized moment log-convexity for centered three-exponential sums
